question: What destructive power can be unleashed when the accomplished practitioner becomes angry?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry
The power to destroy is asserted
The scope includes the entire triple world with moving and unmoving beings
inference: When angry, the accomplished practitioner can destroy the entire triple world, moving and unmoving
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
